meta.name: 病愈连练21天
meta.placeholder: a heroic and joyful chibi girl with long black hair and big sparkling anime eyes, wearing an elegant dress with flowing mint-green ribbons, holding her polished bamboo flute high like a victory torch. A small pink bandage styled like a cute heart is wrapped neatly on her tiny finger, fading into floating sparkling golden pixels to represent full healing, surrounded by a massive burst of shimmering holographic stars, rising phoenix feathers, and colorful musical notes floating into the sky The girl has fully recovered — the heart-shaped bandage is gone, revealing fresh pink new skin on her left forearm like a peach blossom just opened. She holds the flute with her full left hand confidently, eyes sparkling with pride. A complete celebration with rising phoenix feathers, full star bursts, and musical notes streaming skyward in victory.
meta.zh_story: 烫伤后第 21 天。绷带终于摘了, 留下淡粉色的新皮肤 — 像刚开的桃花。她用左手完整握笛, 吹了一首完整的《彩云追月》, 妈妈在手机里录了下来。21 天, 305 次按孔, 0 次放弃。她不再是 "病愈的孩子", 她就是 "会吹笛的孩子"。
meta.cond_text: 宝宝左手小臂烫伤后, 坚持恢复竹笛练习 21 天
